snippet.title: Ready or Not - Console Announcement Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Ready or Not is coming to consoles in Summer 2025. The intense, tactical FPS that redefined close-quarters combat on PC is making its way to consoles, bringing its high-stakes SWAT gameplay to a whole new audience.
